q: 小王是我的同学，他___说三种语言。
zh: 小王是我的同学，他会说三种语言。
py: xiǎo wáng shì wǒ de tóng xué tā huì shuō sān zhǒng yǔ yán
en: Xiao Wang is my classmate; he can speak three languages.
why: Knowing a language is a learned skill, so 会. 可以 would say he is allowed to speak them, which is not the point.

q: 老师___说英语和日语。
zh: 老师会说英语和日语。
py: lǎo shī huì shuō yīng yǔ hé rì yǔ
en: The teacher can speak English and Japanese.
why: Speaking a language you have learned is 会. 可以 means permission and 要 means want or need, neither of which says the teacher knows the languages.

q: 我奶奶从来没学过，不___用电脑。
zh: 我奶奶从来没学过，不会用电脑。
py: wǒ nǎi nai cóng lái méi xué guò bù huì yòng diàn nǎo
en: My grandma has never learned; she can't use a computer.
why: 没学过 says she lacks the know-how, so 不会. 不可以 would mean she is forbidden to use it.

q: 你___开手动挡的车吗？
zh: 你会开手动挡的车吗？
py: nǐ huì kāi shǒu dòng dǎng de chē ma
en: Do you know how to drive a manual car?
why: The question is whether you have learned the skill, so 会. 可以 would ask whether you are allowed to, and 得 means must.

q: 我儿子才两岁，还不___自己穿衣服。
zh: 我儿子才两岁，还不会自己穿衣服。
py: wǒ ér zi cái liǎng suì hái bù huì zì jǐ chuān yī fu
en: My son is only two; he can't dress himself yet.
why: A child who has not yet learned a skill is 不会. 不可以 would mean he is not permitted to dress himself.

q: 她是学音乐的，___弹好几种乐器。
zh: 她是学音乐的，会弹好几种乐器。
py: tā shì xué yīn yuè de huì tán hǎo jǐ zhǒng yuè qì
en: She studied music; she can play several instruments.
why: Training in music shows learned skill, so 会. 可以 would grant permission and 要 would say she wants or needs to play.

q: 我在日本住了一年，已经___说一些简单的日语了。
zh: 我在日本住了一年，已经会说一些简单的日语了。
py: wǒ zài rì běn zhù le yī nián yǐ jīng huì shuō yī xiē jiǎn dān de rì yǔ le
en: I've lived in Japan for a year and can already say some simple Japanese.
why: Having picked up a skill is 会 (with 已经 ... 了 for 'now can'). 要 and 应该 express wanting or obligation, not acquired ability.

q: 我们公司的新同事不___用这个软件，需要有人教他。
zh: 我们公司的新同事不会用这个软件，需要有人教他。
py: wǒ men gōng sī de xīn tóng shì bù huì yòng zhè ge ruǎn jiàn xū yào yǒu rén jiāo tā
en: The new colleague at our company doesn't know how to use this software and needs someone to teach him.
why: Needing to be taught means he has not learned it: 不会. 不可以 would mean he is not allowed to use it, which 需要有人教他 does not suggest.

q: 你___用这个打印机吗？我从来没用过。
zh: 你会用这个打印机吗？我从来没用过。
py: nǐ huì yòng zhè ge dǎ yìn jī ma wǒ cóng lái méi yòng guò
en: Do you know how to use this printer? I've never used it.
why: Asking whether someone knows how to operate something is 会. 可以 would ask whether it is permitted.

q: 天气预报说，明天___下雨。
zh: 天气预报说，明天会下雨。
py: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān huì xià yǔ
en: The forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
why: A forecast predicts what will happen, so 会. 可以 is permission and 能 is ability; rain needs neither.

q: 如果你不告诉老师，他不___知道。
zh: 如果你不告诉老师，他不会知道。
py: rú guǒ nǐ bù gào sù lǎo shī tā bù huì zhī dào
en: If you don't tell the teacher, he won't know.
why: A prediction that something will not happen is 不会. 不能知道 would mean he is not allowed or able to know, which is not the idea here.

q: 你不复习的话，考试___不及格。
zh: 你不复习的话，考试会不及格。
py: nǐ bù fù xí de huà kǎo shì huì bù jí gé
en: If you don't review, you'll fail the exam.
why: The 的话 clause sets up a consequence, and a predicted consequence takes 会. 可以 would turn failing into something permitted.

q: 老板看到这份报告，一定___很高兴。
zh: 老板看到这份报告，一定会很高兴。
py: lǎo bǎn kàn dào zhè fèn bào gào yī dìng huì hěn gāo xìng
en: When the boss sees this report, he'll surely be pleased.
why: 一定 plus a predicted reaction takes 会. 可以 and 能 cannot forecast a feeling.

q: 别担心，这次考试不___很难。
zh: 别担心，这次考试不会很难。
py: bié dān xīn zhè cì kǎo shì bù huì hěn nán
en: Don't worry, this exam won't be very hard.
why: Reassuring about what will turn out is a prediction: 不会. 不能很难 would mean it must not be hard, and 不可以 makes no sense with an exam.

q: 五点以后路上肯定___堵车，我们早点走吧。
zh: 五点以后路上肯定会堵车，我们早点走吧。
py: wǔ diǎn yǐ hòu lù shàng kěn dìng huì dǔ chē wǒ men zǎo diǎn zǒu ba
en: The roads will definitely be jammed after five; let's leave early.
why: 肯定 plus a forecast of traffic takes 会. 可以堵车 would say traffic jams are permitted.

q: 会议九点开始，我觉得经理不___迟到。
zh: 会议九点开始，我觉得经理不会迟到。
py: huì yì jiǔ diǎn kāi shǐ wǒ jué de jīng lǐ bù huì chí dào
en: The meeting starts at nine; I don't think the manager will be late.
why: 我觉得 introduces a guess about what will happen, so 不会. 不能迟到 would be an order that he must not be late.

q: 要是你每天都练习，你的口语一定___进步得很快。
zh: 要是你每天都练习，你的口语一定会进步得很快。
py: yào shi nǐ měi tiān dōu liàn xí nǐ de kǒu yǔ yī dìng huì jìn bù de hěn kuài
en: If you practise every day, your spoken Chinese will definitely improve very fast.
why: 要是 ... 一定 gives a predicted result, so 会. 可以 would turn the improvement into something allowed.

q: 如果公司不给他加薪，他可能___辞职。
zh: 如果公司不给他加薪，他可能会辞职。
py: rú guǒ gōng sī bù gěi tā jiā xīn tā kě néng huì cí zhí
en: If the company doesn't give him a raise, he might quit.
why: 可能 with a predicted action takes 会. 可以 would suggest he is allowed to quit, not that it is likely.

q: 你别难过，李老师不___批评你的。
zh: 你别难过，李老师不会批评你的。
py: nǐ bié nán guò lǐ lǎo shī bù huì pī píng nǐ de
en: Don't be sad; Teacher Li won't criticize you.
why: Comforting someone with 不会 ... 的 predicts what will not happen. 不能 would be an order not to criticize, and 的 is not used with it.

q: 我明天一定会把书带来___。
zh: 我明天一定会把书带来的。
py: wǒ míng tiān yī dìng huì bǎ shū dài lái de
en: I'll definitely bring the book tomorrow.
why: A promise with 会 closes with 的. 了 marks a completed event and clashes with 明天, and 吗 would turn it into a question.

q: 别急，经理马上就___回你电话的。
zh: 别急，经理马上就会回你电话的。
py: bié jí jīng lǐ mǎ shàng jiù huì huí nǐ diàn huà de
en: Don't worry, the manager will call you back right away.
why: The 会 ... 的 frame reassures. 要 does not pair with the closing 的, and 可以 would mean the manager is allowed to call back.

q: 你放心，我们___让你失望的。
zh: 你放心，我们不会让你失望的。
py: nǐ fàng xīn wǒ men bù huì ràng nǐ shī wàng de
en: Rest assured, we won't let you down.
why: A reassurance that something will not happen is 不会 ... 的. 不能 or 不可以 would be about what is not allowed, not a promise.

q: 只要你认真准备，面试官一定___喜欢你的。
zh: 只要你认真准备，面试官一定会喜欢你的。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ rèn zhēn zhǔn bèi miàn shì guān yī dìng huì xǐ huan nǐ de
en: As long as you prepare seriously, the interviewer will surely like you.
why: 一定会 ... 的 predicts and assures. 能 and 可以 cannot express that a feeling will arise.

q: 我会游泳，但是今天感冒了，不___游。
zh: 我会游泳，但是今天感冒了，不能游。
py: wǒ huì yóu yǒng dàn shì jīn tiān gǎn mào le bù néng yóu
en: I can swim, but I have a cold today, so I can't.
why: The skill is there, but today's cold blocks it, so 不能. 不会 would contradict 我会游泳.

q: 他会做饭，可是手受伤了，现在不___做。
zh: 他会做饭，可是手受伤了，现在不能做。
py: tā huì zuò fàn kě shì shǒu shòu shāng le xiàn zài bù néng zuò
en: He knows how to cook, but his hand is hurt, so he can't right now.
why: He has the skill but an injury stops him now: 不能. 不会 would deny the skill that the sentence grants.

q: 她的腿好了，已经___自己走路去上班了。
zh: 她的腿好了，已经能自己走路去上班了。
py: tā de tuǐ hǎo le yǐ jīng néng zì jǐ zǒu lù qù shàng bān le
en: Her leg is better; she can already walk to work by herself.
why: Ability regained after recovery is 能. 会 would describe learning to walk for the first time, like a baby.

q: 对不起，我现在在开会，不___接电话。
zh: 对不起，我现在在开会，不能接电话。
py: duì bu qǐ wǒ xiàn zài zài kāi huì bù néng jiē diàn huà
en: Sorry, I'm in a meeting and can't take calls right now.
why: Being in a meeting is a circumstance that blocks you, so 不能. 不会接电话 would mean you never learned to answer phones.

q: 网络坏了，我们现在不___上网。
zh: 网络坏了，我们现在不能上网。
py: wǎng luò huài le wǒ men xiàn zài bù néng shàng wǎng
en: The network is down, so we can't get online now.
why: The broken network is the circumstance that blocks the action: 不能. 不会 would mean we don't know how to go online, and 不可以 would mean it is forbidden.

q: 病好了，他明天___去上班了。
zh: 病好了，他明天能去上班了。
py: bìng hǎo le tā míng tiān néng qù shàng bān le
en: He's recovered and can go back to work tomorrow.
why: Recovering from illness restores the ability to work: 能 ... 了. 会 would only predict or say he has learned something.

q: 图书馆今天停电了，同学们不___在里面看书。
zh: 图书馆今天停电了，同学们不能在里面看书。
py: tú shū guǎn jīn tiān tíng diàn le tóng xué men bù néng zài lǐ miàn kàn shū
en: The library has a power cut today, so students can't read in there.
why: The power cut is the circumstance that makes reading impossible: 不能. 不会看书 would mean they cannot read at all.

q: 他虽然会说中文，可是今天嗓子哑了，不___说话。
zh: 他虽然会说中文，可是今天嗓子哑了，不能说话。
py: tā suī rán huì shuō zhōng wén kě shì jīn tiān sǎng zi yǎ le bù néng shuō huà
en: Although he can speak Chinese, his voice is hoarse today and he can't speak.
why: 虽然会 grants the skill, and the hoarse throat blocks it today: 不能. 不会 contradicts 会说中文.

q: 我昨天熬夜了，今天太困，实在不___集中注意力。
zh: 我昨天熬夜了，今天太困，实在不能集中注意力。
py: wǒ zuó tiān áo yè le jīn tiān tài kùn shí zài bù néng jí zhōng zhù yì lì
en: I stayed up late yesterday and am so sleepy that I really can't concentrate.
why: Tiredness is the circumstance that blocks concentration, so 不能. 不会 would mean you do not know how to concentrate.

q: 你的脚好点了吗？___走路了吗？
zh: 你的脚好点了吗？能走路了吗？
py: nǐ de jiǎo hǎo diǎn le ma néng zǒu lù le ma
en: Is your foot a bit better? Can you walk now?
why: Asking whether an injury still stops you is 能. 会走路了吗 asks whether someone has learned to walk, which fits a baby, not an injured foot.

q: 他胃口很大，一顿___吃三碗米饭。
zh: 他胃口很大，一顿能吃三碗米饭。
py: tā wèi kǒu hěn dà yī dùn néng chī sān wǎn mǐ fàn
en: He has a big appetite; he can eat three bowls of rice at a meal.
why: An amount (三碗) that a person is able to manage is 能. 会 would make it a prediction that he will eat three bowls.

q: 她打字很快，一分钟___打一百个字。
zh: 她打字很快，一分钟能打一百个字。
py: tā dǎ zì hěn kuài yī fēn zhōng néng dǎ yī bǎi gè zì
en: She types fast; she can type a hundred characters a minute.
why: A speed measured with a number (一百个字 per minute) is capacity, so 能. 会 only says the skill exists.

q: 我每天锻炼，现在___游一千米。
zh: 我每天锻炼，现在能游一千米。
py: wǒ měi tiān duàn liàn xiàn zài néng yóu yī qiān mǐ
en: I exercise every day; now I can swim a thousand metres.
why: A distance (一千米) is an amount of ability, so 能. 会 would just say I know how to swim.

q: 这个教室很大，___坐五十个学生。
zh: 这个教室很大，能坐五十个学生。
py: zhè ge jiào shì hěn dà néng zuò wǔ shí gè xué sheng
en: This classroom is big and can seat fifty students.
why: The capacity of a room is a number it can hold, so 能. 会坐五十个学生 would say it will seat fifty, not that it has room for them.

q: 他记性好，一天___背五十个生词。
zh: 他记性好，一天能背五十个生词。
py: tā jì xìng hǎo yī tiān néng bèi wǔ shí gè shēng cí
en: He has a good memory; he can memorize fifty new words a day.
why: 五十个生词 per day measures his capacity, so 能. 会 would not mean he is able to reach that amount.

q: 她每天都锻炼，一口气___跑五公里。
zh: 她每天都锻炼，一口气能跑五公里。
py: tā měi tiān dōu duàn liàn yī kǒu qì néng pǎo wǔ gōng lǐ
en: She exercises every day; she can run five kilometres in one go.
why: A distance reached in one breath (五公里) is capacity: 能. 会 would only say she knows how to run.

q: 这个软件很先进，一秒钟就___翻译上千个句子。
zh: 这个软件很先进，一秒钟就能翻译上千个句子。
py: zhè ge ruǎn jiàn hěn xiān jìn yī miǎo zhōng jiù néng fān yì shàng qiān gè jù zi
en: This software is advanced; it can translate thousands of sentences in a second.
why: Speed with a number (一秒钟 ... 上千个句子) is 能. 会 would predict that it will translate them, not describe its capacity.

q: 我们的电梯很大，一次___坐十五个人。
zh: 我们的电梯很大，一次能坐十五个人。
py: wǒ men de diàn tī hěn dà yī cì néng zuò shí wǔ gè rén
en: Our lift is big and can carry fifteen people at a time.
why: The number of people the lift holds is a capacity, so 能. 会 would only predict that fifteen people will sit.

q: 我一个小时___写五十个汉字。
zh: 我一个小时能写五十个汉字。
py: wǒ yī gè xiǎo shí néng xiě wǔ shí gè hàn zì
en: I can write fifty characters in an hour.
why: An amount in a time span (五十个汉字 per hour) is capacity: 能. 会 would say only that I can write characters.

q: 老师，我___进来吗？
zh: 老师，我可以进来吗？
py: lǎo shī wǒ kě yǐ jìn lái ma
en: Teacher, may I come in?
why: Asking permission is 可以 ... 吗. 会 would ask whether I will come in, and 要 would ask whether I want to.

q: 这儿___拍照，你拍吧。
zh: 这儿可以拍照，你拍吧。
py: zhè r kě yǐ pāi zhào nǐ pāi ba
en: You may take photos here; go ahead.
why: A place where something is permitted takes 可以. 会拍照 would say people know how to take photos.

q: 去公司你___坐地铁，比开车快。
zh: 去公司你可以坐地铁，比开车快。
py: qù gōng sī nǐ kě yǐ zuò dì tiě bǐ kāi chē kuài
en: You could take the subway to the office; it's faster than driving.
why: Offering an option is 可以. 会 would predict that you will take the subway.

q: 我___用一下你的笔吗？
zh: 我可以用一下你的笔吗？
py: wǒ kě yǐ yòng yī xià nǐ de bǐ ma
en: May I use your pen for a moment?
why: Asking permission is 可以. 会 would ask whether I will or know how to use a pen.

q: 学生___在图书馆借五本书。
zh: 学生可以在图书馆借五本书。
py: xué sheng kě yǐ zài tú shū guǎn jiè wǔ běn shū
en: Students may borrow five books from the library.
why: A rule about what is allowed takes 可以. 会 would be a prediction about what students will do.

q: 有问题你___问老师，不用不好意思。
zh: 有问题你可以问老师，不用不好意思。
py: yǒu wèn tí nǐ kě yǐ wèn lǎo shī bù yòng bù hǎo yì sī
en: If you have a question, you can ask the teacher; no need to be shy.
why: Telling someone an option is open is 可以. 得 means must, which clashes with 不用不好意思.

q: 今天太忙了，我们___叫外卖吃。
zh: 今天太忙了，我们可以叫外卖吃。
py: jīn tiān tài máng le wǒ men kě yǐ jiào wài mài chī
en: We're too busy today; we could order takeout.
why: Suggesting an option is 可以. 会 would predict that we will order takeout.

q: 如果你对这个方案有不同的意见，___在会议上提出来。
zh: 如果你对这个方案有不同的意见，可以在会议上提出来。
py: rú guǒ nǐ duì zhè ge fāng àn yǒu bù tóng de yì jiàn kě yǐ zài huì yì shàng tí chū lái
en: If you have a different opinion about this plan, you can raise it at the meeting.
why: Pointing out an open option is 可以. 能 is about ability and 会 is a prediction, so neither fits as a suggestion.

q: 你的作业如果没写完，___明天早上交给我。
zh: 你的作业如果没写完，可以明天早上交给我。
py: nǐ de zuò yè rú guǒ méi xiě wán kě yǐ míng tiān zǎo shang jiāo gěi wǒ
en: If you haven't finished your homework, you can hand it in to me tomorrow morning.
why: Granting an option is 可以. 会 would predict, and 能 would talk about whether you are able, not about what the teacher allows.

q: 经理，我___明天再交报告吗？
zh: 经理，我可以明天再交报告吗？
py: jīng lǐ wǒ kě yǐ míng tiān zài jiāo bào gào ma
en: Manager, may I hand in the report tomorrow instead?
why: Asking the boss for leave to do it later is permission: 可以. 会 would ask whether I will, which is not a request.

q: 对不起，我明天要出差，___去参加你的婚礼。
zh: 对不起，我明天要出差，不能去参加你的婚礼。
py: duì bu qǐ wǒ míng tiān yào chū chāi bù néng qù cān jiā nǐ de hūn lǐ
en: Sorry, I have a business trip tomorrow, so I can't come to your wedding.
why: 'Can't make it' because of circumstances is 不能. 不可以 would mean someone forbids you to go.

q: 我从来没学过，不___做饭，每天都在外面吃。
zh: 我从来没学过，不会做饭，每天都在外面吃。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi xué guò bù huì zuò fàn měi tiān dōu zài wài miàn chī
en: I've never learned; I can't cook, so I eat out every day.
why: 没学过 means no know-how: 不会. 不可以 would mean cooking is forbidden, which has nothing to do with eating out.

q: 下个星期我不___去上海，我去北京。
zh: 下个星期我不会去上海，我去北京。
py: xià gè xīng qī wǒ bù huì qù shàng hǎi wǒ qù běi jīng
en: I won't go to Shanghai next week; I'm going to Beijing.
why: Saying what will not happen is 不会. 不能 would say I am unable to go and does not fit announcing a different destination.

q: 老师说，上课的时候___玩手机。
zh: 老师说，上课的时候不可以玩手机。
py: lǎo shī shuō shàng kè de shí hou bù kě yǐ wán shǒu jī
en: The teacher said you may not play on your phone during class.
why: A rule the teacher lays down is 不可以. 不会 would mean students don't know how to, and 不想 would give personal wishes.

q: 对不起，会议还没结束，你现在不___进去。
zh: 对不起，会议还没结束，你现在不能进去。
py: duì bu qǐ huì yì hái méi jié shù nǐ xiàn zài bù néng jìn qù
en: Sorry, the meeting isn't over, so you can't go in right now.
why: The unfinished meeting blocks entry, so 不能. 不会进去 would predict you will not enter.

q: 我可以用你的电脑吗？不___，我还要用。
zh: 我可以用你的电脑吗？不行，我还要用。
py: wǒ kě yǐ yòng nǐ de diàn nǎo ma bù xíng wǒ hái yào yòng
en: May I use your computer? No, I'm still using it.
why: The natural refusal to 可以 ... 吗 is 不行. 不会 is never an answer to a request, and 不用 means 'no need'.

q: 因为公司有规定，上班时间员工不___在办公室里吃饭。
zh: 因为公司有规定，上班时间员工不可以在办公室里吃饭。
py: yīn wèi gōng sī yǒu guī dìng shàng bān shí jiān yuán gōng bù kě yǐ zài bàn gōng shì lǐ chī fàn
en: Because of company rules, staff may not eat in the office during working hours.
why: A company rule is a prohibition: 不可以. 不会 would claim staff simply don't eat there.

q: 你不用担心，这种小病不___影响你的工作。
zh: 你不用担心，这种小病不会影响你的工作。
py: nǐ bù yòng dān xīn zhè zhǒng xiǎo bìng bù huì yǐng xiǎng nǐ de gōng zuò
en: Don't worry; this kind of minor illness won't affect your work.
why: Reassuring about what will not happen is 不会. 不能影响 would be an order that it must not affect your work.

q: 她很___做饭，每个人都说好吃。
zh: 她很会做饭，每个人都说好吃。
py: tā hěn huì zuò fàn měi gè rén dōu shuō hǎo chī
en: She's really good at cooking; everyone says it tastes good.
why: Skill plus 很 is 很会 + verb. 可以 cannot take 很, and 很能做饭 does not mean skilful.

q: 我弟弟很___吃，一顿吃五碗饭。
zh: 我弟弟很能吃，一顿吃五碗饭。
py: wǒ dì di hěn néng chī yī dùn chī wǔ wǎn fàn
en: My little brother can really eat; he has five bowls of rice at a meal.
why: Eating a lot is 很能吃. 很会吃 would mean he knows good food, and 可以 cannot take 很.

q: 他很___说话，同事们都喜欢他。
zh: 他很会说话，同事们都喜欢他。
py: tā hěn huì shuō huà tóng shì men dōu xǐ huan tā
en: He's good with words; his colleagues all like him.
why: Being skilful at speaking tactfully is 很会说话. 很能 points to capacity or quantity, not skill.

q: 这个孩子真___睡，一口气睡了十二个小时。
zh: 这个孩子真能睡，一口气睡了十二个小时。
py: zhè ge hái zi zhēn néng shuì yī kǒu qì shuì le shí èr gè xiǎo shí
en: This child can really sleep; he slept twelve hours straight.
why: Twelve hours is an amount, so 真能睡 (a large capacity). 会 would praise a skill, and 可以 cannot follow 真.

q: 我们的经理特别___安排时间，所有工作都按时完成。
zh: 我们的经理特别会安排时间，所有工作都按时完成。
py: wǒ men de jīng lǐ tè bié huì ān pái shí jiān suǒ yǒu gōng zuò dōu àn shí wán chéng
en: Our manager is especially good at scheduling; all the work is finished on time.
why: Scheduling well is a skill, so 特别会. 能 would stress capacity, and 可以 does not follow 特别.

s: 我没学过游泳，所以我不可以游泳。
s_py: wǒ méi xué guò yóu yǒng suǒ yǐ wǒ bù kě yǐ yóu yǒng
zh: 我没学过游泳，所以我不会游泳。
py: wǒ méi xué guò yóu yǒng suǒ yǐ wǒ bù huì yóu yǒng
en: I've never learned to swim, so I can't swim.
why: 没学过 means no know-how, which is 不会. 不可以 means it is forbidden.

s: 我会开车，但是我不会开手动挡的车。
s_py: wǒ huì kāi chē dàn shì wǒ bù huì kāi shǒu dòng dǎng de chē
zh: 我会开车，但是我不会开手动挡的车。
py: wǒ huì kāi chē dàn shì wǒ bù huì kāi shǒu dòng dǎng de chē
en: I can drive, but I can't drive a manual car.
why: Both halves are about learned skill, so 会 and 不会 are right; the second 不会 narrows the skill and does not contradict the first.

s: 天气预报说，明天可以下大雨。
s_py: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān kě yǐ xià dà yǔ
zh: 天气预报说，明天会下大雨。
py: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān huì xià dà yǔ
en: The forecast says it will rain heavily tomorrow.
why: A forecast is a prediction, so 会. 可以 would make rain something permitted.

s: 你要是迟到，老师会不高兴的。
s_py: nǐ yào shi chí dào lǎo shī huì bù gāo xìng de
zh: 你要是迟到，老师会不高兴的。
py: nǐ yào shi chí dào lǎo shī huì bù gāo xìng de
en: If you're late, the teacher will be unhappy.
why: 会 predicts the teacher's reaction and 的 closes the sentence; 会不高兴 (will be unhappy) is a normal order, with no 不会 needed.

s: 吃这么多糖，你可以牙疼。
s_py: chī zhè me duō táng nǐ kě yǐ yá téng
zh: 吃这么多糖，你会牙疼。
py: chī zhè me duō táng nǐ huì yá téng
en: Eating that much sugar, you'll get a toothache.
why: A consequence is predicted with 会. 可以 would say you are allowed to have a toothache.

s: 放心，我会的给你打电话。
s_py: fàng xīn wǒ huì de gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
zh: 放心，我会给你打电话的。
py: fàng xīn wǒ huì gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà de
en: Don't worry, I'll call you.
why: In 会 ... 的 the 的 closes the whole sentence; it cannot sit between 会 and the verb phrase.

s: 你放心，他一定会按时到的。
s_py: nǐ fàng xīn tā yī dìng huì àn shí dào de
zh: 你放心，他一定会按时到的。
py: nǐ fàng xīn tā yī dìng huì àn shí dào de
en: Rest assured, he will definitely arrive on time.
why: 一定会 ... 的 is the standard assurance: 会 for the prediction and 的 at the very end, with no 了.

s: 我明天会去看你了。
s_py: wǒ míng tiān huì qù kàn nǐ le
zh: 我明天会去看你的。
py: wǒ míng tiān huì qù kàn nǐ de
en: I'll come and see you tomorrow.
why: A future promise with 会 ends in 的. 了 marks a completed event or a new situation and cannot close a sentence about tomorrow.

s: 我会开车，但是今天喝酒了，不会开车。
s_py: wǒ huì kāi chē dàn shì jīn tiān hē jiǔ le bù huì kāi chē
zh: 我会开车，但是今天喝酒了，不能开车。
py: wǒ huì kāi chē dàn shì jīn tiān hē jiǔ le bù néng kāi chē
en: I can drive, but I've been drinking today, so I can't drive.
why: The skill is granted by 我会开车, so the second clause needs the circumstance modal 不能. 不会开车 would contradict the first clause.

s: 他会说法语，可是今天嗓子疼，不能说话。
s_py: tā huì shuō fǎ yǔ kě shì jīn tiān sǎng zi téng bù néng shuō huà
zh: 他会说法语，可是今天嗓子疼，不能说话。
py: tā huì shuō fǎ yǔ kě shì jīn tiān sǎng zi téng bù néng shuō huà
en: He can speak French, but his throat hurts today, so he can't talk.
why: Both modals are correct: 会 for the skill and 不能 for today's blocking circumstance.

s: 网络不好，我现在不会发邮件。
s_py: wǎng luò bù hǎo wǒ xiàn zài bù huì fā yóu jiàn
zh: 网络不好，我现在不能发邮件。
py: wǎng luò bù hǎo wǒ xiàn zài bù néng fā yóu jiàn
en: The network is bad, so I can't send emails right now.
why: A bad network is a circumstance, so 不能. 不会发邮件 would mean you never learned how to send email.

s: 我们公司的电梯一次会坐十个人。
s_py: wǒ men gōng sī de diàn tī yī cì huì zuò shí gè rén
zh: 我们公司的电梯一次能坐十个人。
py: wǒ men gōng sī de diàn tī yī cì néng zuò shí gè rén
en: Our company's lift can carry ten people at a time.
why: A number of people the lift holds is capacity, so 能. 会 would be a prediction and is wrong for describing a lift.

s: 我会游泳，可是一次只能游五十米。
s_py: wǒ huì yóu yǒng kě shì yī cì zhǐ néng yóu wǔ shí mǐ
zh: 我会游泳，可是一次只能游五十米。
py: wǒ huì yóu yǒng kě shì yī cì zhǐ néng yóu wǔ shí mǐ
en: I can swim, but I can only swim fifty metres at a time.
why: 会 names the skill, and 能 with a distance (五十米) measures how much of it I can manage; the two do not clash.

s: 老师，我会出去一下吗？
s_py: lǎo shī wǒ huì chū qù yī xià ma
zh: 老师，我可以出去一下吗？
py: lǎo shī wǒ kě yǐ chū qù yī xià ma
en: Teacher, may I step out for a moment?
why: Asking permission needs 可以. 会 would ask whether I will go out, which is not a request.

s: 你可以明天再交作业。
s_py: nǐ kě yǐ míng tiān zài jiāo zuò yè
zh: 你可以明天再交作业。
py: nǐ kě yǐ míng tiān zài jiāo zuò yè
en: You can hand in the homework tomorrow instead.
why: Granting an option or permission is 可以; 再 after 明天 just means 'only then', so there is no clash.

s: 我明天要加班，不可以来参加你的生日会。
s_py: wǒ míng tiān yào jiā bān bù kě yǐ lái cān jiā nǐ de shēng rì huì
zh: 我明天要加班，不能来参加你的生日会。
py: wǒ míng tiān yào jiā bān bù néng lái cān jiā nǐ de shēng rì huì
en: I have to work overtime tomorrow, so I can't come to your birthday party.
why: 'Can't make it' because of work is 不能. 不可以 would mean someone forbids you to come.

s: 这个办公室里不可以抽烟。
s_py: zhè ge bàn gōng shì lǐ bù kě yǐ chōu yān
zh: 这个办公室里不可以抽烟。
py: zhè ge bàn gōng shì lǐ bù kě yǐ chōu yān
en: Smoking is not allowed in this office.
why: A rule or prohibition takes 不可以. It is a correct, slightly formal alternative to 不能.

s: 我可以先走吗？不会，你再等一下。
s_py: wǒ kě yǐ xiān zǒu ma bù huì nǐ zài děng yī xià
zh: 我可以先走吗？不行，你再等一下。
py: wǒ kě yǐ xiān zǒu ma bù xíng nǐ zài děng yī xià
en: May I leave first? No, wait a little longer.
why: Refusing a request for permission takes 不行 (or 不能). 不会 predicts or denies know-how and is never an answer to 可以 ... 吗.

s: 他很可以说话，大家都喜欢听他讲。
s_py: tā hěn kě yǐ shuō huà dà jiā dōu xǐ huan tīng tā jiǎng
zh: 他很会说话，大家都喜欢听他讲。
py: tā hěn huì shuō huà dà jiā dōu xǐ huan tīng tā jiǎng
en: He's good with words; everyone likes listening to him.
why: Being skilful is 很会. 可以 cannot be modified by 很 to mean good at.

s: 我哥哥很能吃，一个人吃了两个蛋糕。
s_py: wǒ gē ge hěn néng chī yī gè rén chī le liǎng gè dàn gāo
zh: 我哥哥很能吃，一个人吃了两个蛋糕。
py: wǒ gē ge hěn néng chī yī gè rén chī le liǎng gè dàn gāo
en: My older brother can really eat; he ate two cakes by himself.
why: 很能吃 means eating a great deal, which the amount in the second clause confirms; 很会吃 would mean he knows good food.

zh: 我会说一点儿中文。
py: wǒ huì shuō yī diǎn r zhōng wén
en: I can speak a little Chinese.
why: The modal 会 goes before the verb and the object follows it. 一点儿中文 stays after 说.

zh: 明天下午会下大雨。
py: míng tiān xià wǔ huì xià dà yǔ
en: It will rain heavily tomorrow afternoon.
why: The time phrase comes first, then 会 before the verb 下. Putting 会 after 下大雨 would break the sentence.

zh: 经理一定会同意的。
py: jīng lǐ yī dìng huì tóng yì de
en: The manager will definitely agree.
why: 一定 comes before 会, and 的 closes the assurance. 的 cannot go between 会 and 同意.

zh: 只要你好好复习，你一定会通过的。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ hǎo hǎo fù xí nǐ yī dìng huì tōng guò de
en: As long as you review properly, you'll definitely pass.
why: The 一定会 ... 的 assurance keeps 的 last in its clause; the 只要 clause may come before or after it.

zh: 我今天发烧了，所以不能上班。
py: wǒ jīn tiān fā shāo le suǒ yǐ bù néng shàng bān
en: I have a fever today, so I can't go to work.
why: The fever is the circumstance, so 不能 follows 所以. 不会 would say you never learned to work.

zh: 她一分钟能打一百个字。
py: tā yī fēn zhōng néng dǎ yī bǎi gè zì
en: She can type a hundred characters a minute.
why: The time span sits before 能, and the amount follows the verb. 能 cannot come after 打.

zh: 这个会议室一次能坐二十个人。
py: zhè ge huì yì shì yī cì néng zuò èr shí gè rén
en: This meeting room can seat twenty people at a time.
why: Capacity is measured by an amount after the verb (二十个人), with 能 before 坐; 一次 may sit before or after 能.

zh: 我可以坐在这儿吗？
py: wǒ kě yǐ zuò zài zhè r ma
en: May I sit here?
why: 可以 comes before the verb phrase, and 吗 ends the permission question.

zh: 学生上课时不可以玩手机。
py: xué sheng shàng kè shí bù kě yǐ wán shǒu jī
en: Students may not play on their phones during class.
why: 不可以 sits right before the verb phrase, in front of 玩手机. A rule laid down for students is 不可以.

zh: 我同事很会安排时间。
py: wǒ tóng shì hěn huì ān pái shí jiān
en: My colleague is very good at scheduling.
why: 很 comes before 会, which comes before the verb phrase. 很可以 would not work.

src_py: wǒ míng tiān gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
task: Make it a promise with 会 ... 的.
zh: 我明天会给你打电话的。
py: wǒ míng tiān huì gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà de
en: I'll call you tomorrow.
why: Add 会 before the coverb phrase and put 的 at the very end; the time word may come before or after the subject.

src_py: nǐ kě yǐ zài zhè r chōu yān
task: Make it a prohibition with 不能.
zh: 你不能在这儿抽烟。
py: nǐ bù néng zài zhè r chōu yān
en: You can't smoke here.
why: The negative goes directly before the verb phrase: 不能在这儿抽烟. 不 cannot negate 可以 here to mean 'unable'.

src_py: tā yī dùn chī sān wǎn mǐ fàn
task: Say he is able to eat that much, using 能.
zh: 他一顿能吃三碗米饭。
py: tā yī dùn néng chī sān wǎn mǐ fàn
en: He can eat three bowls of rice at a meal.
why: An amount reached (三碗) is expressed with 能 before the verb. 会 would turn it into a prediction.

src_py: wǒ yòng yī xià nǐ de diàn nǎo
task: Turn it into a polite request with 可以 ... 吗.
zh: 我可以用一下你的电脑吗？
py: wǒ kě yǐ yòng yī xià nǐ de diàn nǎo ma
en: May I use your computer for a moment?
why: Asking permission puts 可以 before the verb and 吗 at the end; the object can also be fronted as a topic.

task: Say it will not rain tomorrow, using 不会.
zh: 明天不会下雨。
py: míng tiān bù huì xià yǔ
en: It won't rain tomorrow.
why: A prediction that something will not happen is 不会 before the verb. 不能 or 不可以 would be about ability or permission.
